title: Aneessa released a new single titled " I found myself in you"
htmlContent:
Aneessa is a songwriter, producer, and musician based in France, a wonderful and talented songwriter who has been in the industry for a long time and has worked with many big names in music, like Motown music producers.

"I found myself in you" is a retro soul and soft music that speaks directly to your soul, and it is written by both Aneessa and her husband, Michael B. Sutton. The song is all about their love and celebrating their wedding anniversary. "

I found myself in you" is all about love, and how they complete each other, the vocal performance and beautiful lyrics of the song speak nothing but true love and how far their love has gone. This song is a celebration of love and companionship, and it brings out the couple's deep feelings for each other.

Aneessa has made her mark over two decades in the music industry and is not slowing down. She does not only make music, but she also runs a company that helps fast-rising stars.

"I found myself in you" is the song that renews your love for your partner. It sets the mood and brings in the romantic air. Knowing much about Aneessa, we had to feature her on our page.

Stream " I found myself in you" on YouTube.
